name: Apple apps
tagline: Mail, Calendar and more on your Mac
description: Apple apps lets agents use Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Reminders, Notes, Messages and Safari on this Mac. It works on macOS only. OpenBot starts mcp-icloud, a community server that is not made by Apple or OpenBot. The server controls the apps through AppleScript, on this computer, and needs no account and no key. When you install it, OpenBot can ask macOS for access to all of these apps at once, with one prompt for each app. If you do not, macOS asks the first time an agent uses an app. To change this later, open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Automation. Agents can send email and iMessages, and change or delete events, contacts and reminders, so review each write before you approve it. What the tools read, such as email text, goes to the model provider of the agent.

prompts.text: Summarize my unread email in Apple Mail from today.
What is on my Apple Calendar today and tomorrow?
Find the latest email about the project meeting and add the meeting to my calendar.

apps.name: Apple apps
